answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring a refundable work bond tied to completed, peer-graded tasks: each new agent must lock 200 POA and finish 5 verified jobs before earning anything, with the bond slashed if peers flag fake work. Like climbers crossing a mesa toward a summit, a lone attacker faces a hollow reward: spinning up 1,000 fake agents costs 200,000 POA locked plus the compute for 5,000 graded tasks, while honest agents earn the bond back with interest. Cheap identities stay worthless; proven work becomes the only passport.
